text_blocks.text: Give me some of the guys in your class where you think will be all-NBA and have a potential Hall of Fame career when it's all said and done.

text_blocks.speaker: Mikel Brown Jr.
text_blocks.text: Obviously you got the core four, I think, Caleb Wilson, Caleb Wilson, Cam Boozer, because his impact on winning. I mean, you seen it through high school and you seen it through college. He's a winner. So, him, then DP and AJ, obviously, I think are going to be all-NBA guys at some point as well. Myself, Darius Acuff as well, I think he has that talent as well to be to be like that.

quotes.speaker: Mikel Brown Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikel Brown Jr. on learning to prioritize recovery from injury
quotes.excerpt: I also learned how to prioritize what I needed to prioritize. I was prioritizing trying to get back on the court as fast as possible, and that didn't help out.
quotes.quote: Adversity is going to come your way, it's inevitable, so you might as well get used to it because you're going to hit adversity at some point again. And two, I also learned how to prioritize what I needed to prioritize. I was prioritizing trying to get back on the court as fast as possible, and that didn't help out. You can't rush that back, trust me. I dealt with my back the entire career and it was just finding ways to just be able to get on the court and be consistent at that.
